question: Who reaches Krishna and how does Vasudeva's teaching lead to knowing?
premises: The devotee who acts for Krishna reaches him
Devotion shines forth for those without other knowable pleasant things
Vasudeva approaches them and all is given
From wonder at the previously stated teaching
The world-souled Vasudeva-principle descends effortlessly into the path of knowing
inference: Devotion and Krishna-centered action bring the devotee to Krishna, while the teaching's wonder makes the universal Vasudeva-principle accessible as knowing.
uncertainties: Fused editorial tokens are kept as given
plain_english: He who does my works, is devoted to me, is free from attachment, and is without enmity toward all beings reaches me, O Pandava. For those whose devotion shines forth toward no other knowable pleasant thing, Vasudeva approaches them; all. From the wonder of the previously stated teaching, the world-souled Vasudeva-principle descends effortlessly into the path of knowing. Auspicious. 60.
